Basic ATC

Ожидайте

An instruction meaning 'wait and I will call you'; it indicates that the controller or pilot is temporarily unable to communicate.

Why it matters

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Ожидайте?

In this glossary, Ожидайте refers to: An instruction meaning 'wait and I will call you'; it indicates that the controller or pilot is temporarily unable to communicate.

How is Ожидайте used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Башня: G-ABCD, ожидайте дальнейших указаний."

Why does Ожидайте matter in aviation?

Ожидайте matters because it supports clear communication in Basic ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Ожидайте?

Ожидайте is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Ожидайте belong to?

Where does this definition come from?

Definition
